payload.claim: The docstring says the fresh dir having no refs means 'base_sha and HEAD are resolved to shas first', but the script (lines 236-245) only resolves HEAD via `rev-parse HEAD` (line 239); `base_sha` is passed straight through as the positional `$1` and used unresolved in the range `"$1..$head"` (line 245). This is harmless today only because every caller already hands `export_patch` a full commit sha (`CellSpec.tree_base`/`base_sha`, guaranteed resolved upstream), and if that invariant were ever violated the diff would fail loudly with 'unknown revision' rather than silently misbehave, so this is a documentation mismatch rather than a live defect.
